mocap.settings.info.about.prevent_tracki: Prevents tracking (recording) entities that are currently played
mocap.settings.info.about.entity_trackin: Limits the entity tracking distance (>0 - tracking radius in blocks; 0 - disable tracking; -1 - distance not limited)
mocap.settings.info.about.on_death: Determines what will happen when recorded player dies (end_recording - ends recording; split_recording - splits recording; continue_synced - continues recording and records all ticks on death screen (when game is waiting for player to respawn); continue_skip_ticks - continues recording but skips ticks on death screen (player is recorded as if it respawned immediately))
mocap.settings.info.about.on_change_dime: Determines what will happen when recorded player changes dimension (nothing - ignores dimension change, not recommended in most cases as player and other recorded entities will appear somewhere in a dimension they are not supposed to be in; end_recording - ends recording; split_recording - splits recording)
mocap.settings.info.about.start_instantl: Makes recording start instantly instead of waiting for movement or second command
mocap.settings.info.about.assign_dimensi: Assigns dimension to the recording. See "dimension_source" setting (in "playback" category) for more information.
mocap.settings.info.about.assign_player_: Assigns recorded player name to the recording. You also need to enable "start_as_recorded" for a recording playback to start as recorded player by default.
mocap.settings.info.about.playback_speed: Allows you to change speed of played recording or scene
mocap.settings.info.about.can_push_entit: Makes fake players push other entities
mocap.settings.info.about.entities_after: Determines what will happen with entities after playback (remove - remove; kill - kill with animation; left_untouched - left untouched; release_as_normal - release it as a normal entity)
mocap.settings.info.about.block_actions_: Plays back placing, destroying, and interacting with blocks
mocap.settings.info.about.block_initiali: At the playback start sets block states to those before the start of recording
mocap.settings.info.about.block_allow_sc: Allows playback of block actions with scene scaled by natural number. Note that it may cause major destruction of the terrain, so it's recommended to backup your world before using it.
mocap.settings.info.about.drop_from_bloc: Enables drop from destroyed blocks (recommended with "playItemEntities" disabled to prevent duplicates)
mocap.settings.info.about.start_as_recor: Makes playback start as recorded player, rather than player starting playback. In case of saved recordings you need to start them with "assign_player_name" enabled.
mocap.settings.info.about.chat_playback: Enables player chat messages playback. Note that recording needs to be recorded with "chat_recording" enabled.
mocap.settings.info.about.invulnerable_p: Makes player and other entities in the playback invulnerable to damage
mocap.settings.info.about.dimension_sour: Specifies in which dimension playback will start (assigned_or_current - dimension assigned to the recording or, if it wasn't assigned, dimension of player/command block starting playback; assigned_or_overworld - dimension assigned to the recording or, if it wasn't assigned, overworld; current - ignores assigned dimension and always uses dimension of player/command block starting playback; overworld - ignores assigned dimension and always uses overworld)
mocap.settings.info.about.fluent_movemen: Sets distance to played entity for player to receive additional packets for more fluent movements (>0 - distance in blocks; 0 - disable fluent movements; -1 - no limit)
mocap.settings.info.about.movement_preci: Sets precision of recording player movement - absolute value of difference between desired position offset and calculated offset won't be higher than 1/val
mocap.settings.info.about.precise_rotati: Increases played head rotation precision (recordings also need to be recorded with higher precision for it to make take affect)
mocap.settings.info.about.allow_mineskin: Allows HTTPS requests to mineskin.org in order to load skins
mocap.settings.info.about.prevent_saving: Prevents game from saving played entities in case of for example leaving game
mocap.settings.info.about.use_creative_g: Sets fake players game mode to creative (monsters will ignore them)
mocap.settings.info.about.allow_ghosts: Allows usage of ghosts (invisible, server-side only players) when using "player_as_entity" modifier. They're created in order to perform actions that can't be done by a non-player entity.
mocap.settings.info.about.experimental_r: Warns players when a server is using experimental (alpha or beta) release of Motion Capture mod
mocap.settings.info.about.pretty_scene_f: Makes scene JSON files look pretty, at cost of slightly bigger file size (scene files are very small anyway, so it shouldn't be a problem unless you're using punch cards for storing them)
mocap.settings.info.about.show_tips: Gives tips that may help with using the mod
mocap.settings.info.about.quick_discard: Allows to quickly discard single recording by reusing "stop" command

mocap.help:
%s - §lHelp§r
  /mocap recording [...] - Recording player movements
  /mocap recordings [...] - Managing recording files
  /mocap scenes [...] - Creating and modifying scenes
  /mocap playback [...] - Playback of scenes and recordings
  /mocap settings [...] - Shows and modifies settings
  /mocap info - Displays information about mod
  /mocap help - Displays this message
§lHow to use:§r
- First, you need to start recording using "/mocap recording start". It will record all your movements or movements of a player given as an argument. 
- Then, you can stop recording using "/mocap recording stop" and save it with "/mocap recording save <name>".
- Use "/mocap playback start <name>" to play recording.
- You can also create scenes to which you can add multiple recordings or other scenes, with parameters like player name, position offset, or start delay.
- To create scene use "/mocap scenes add <scene_name>". Then, add your recording using "/mocap scenes add_to <scene_name> <recording_name> [player_name] [skin_source_type] [skin_source]" (you can skip arguments in square brackets if you want).
- To play scene use "/mocap playback start .<scene_name>" - you need to put a dot before the scene name.
- By putting a dot before name, when using "/mocap scenes add_to ...", you can also add scenes to other scenes.
